title: Stop follow-ups once they act
blurb: Use a goal so people who book or pay skip the rest of the chasers.

steps.title: Why use a goal
steps.body: Nothing annoys a customer more than a "still keen?" text after they have already booked. A goal jumps them past the chasers.

steps.title: Add a Goal Event
steps.body: Open your follow-up workflow. Click **+** near the end and choose **Goal Event**.

steps.title: Pick the goal
steps.body: Choose what counts as success, like an appointment booked, an invoice paid, a form submitted or the contact replied.

steps.title: Decide what happens
steps.body: Choose **Continue anyway**, **Wait until the goal is met** or **End this workflow** for people who reach this step without hitting the goal.

target.text: Wait until the goal is met

steps.lookFor: Wait until the goal is met
steps.tip: Each workflow can have one Goal Event, but it can hold several goals.

steps.title: Save, test and publish
steps.body: Click **Save**. Run **Test Workflow** on your own contact, then switch **Draft** to **Publish** and save again.
steps.tip: Nothing is sent until the workflow is published.
